Home.title: A quiet commerce starting point
Home.description: A clean tenant-neutral Next.js storefront base for product, cart, checkout, and account flows.
Home.capabilityCatalogDescription: Product detail and purchase controls reserve space for the API integration.
Home.capabilityCartDescription: Empty cart, summary, and checkout transition sit in a calm rhythm.
Home.capabilityCheckoutDescription: Address, payment, and review steps are visible before business rules arrive.
Home.capabilityAccountDescription: Account, order list, and detail pages share one storefront language.

ProductListing.title: Explore products
ProductListing.description: Search published products, move through pages, and continue to detail for variant selection.
ProductListing.emptyDescription: Change the search term or check back later.
ProductListing.errorDescription: The product listing request could not be completed.

Product.title: Product Detail
Product.description: Real product variants, price, and purchase controls will be connected in the next API slice.
Product.controlsNote: This area will fill with live product API data.
Product.addedToCartDescription: Your cart summary has been updated.
Product.unavailableDescription: There is no in-stock variant available for this product right now.
Product.errorDescription: The add-to-cart request could not be completed.

Cart.title: Cart
Cart.description: Cart state and line operations will be added with the next API integration.
Cart.summaryNote: There are no items in your cart yet.
Cart.emptyDescription: Selected items will appear here after product listing and add-to-cart flows are connected.
Cart.errorDescription: The cart request could not be completed.

Checkout.title: Checkout
Checkout.description: Address selection, summary, and payment initialization will be built here.
Checkout.stepAddressDescription: Delivery and billing snapshots will be filled by the customer API.
Checkout.stepPaymentDescription: Hosted payment attempt initialization will start here.
Checkout.stepReviewDescription: Stock, price, and legal snapshot checks will be shown.

CheckoutReturn.title: Payment Return
CheckoutReturn.description: The iyzico hosted payment result will be interpreted through this route.
CheckoutReturn.summaryNote: Provider results are not read through the API yet.

Account.title: Account
Account.description: Profile, addresses, and customer session flows will grow here.
Account.profileDescription: Customer identity and contact information will appear here.
Account.addressesDescription: Delivery and billing addresses will connect to the customer API.
Account.ordersDescription: Order history and detail flow will be reached from here.

Orders.title: My Orders
Orders.description: Customer order history and details will be connected in later integrations.
Orders.emptyDescription: Paid orders will appear here after payment finalization is connected.

NotFound.title: Page Not Found
NotFound.description: The requested commerce page is not defined in this shell.

Error.title: Something Went Wrong
Error.description: An error occurred while loading the page.
Error.rootDescription: Commerce storefront could not complete the request.
